an eliminate() teardown that releases owned resources (scene, plot_data, line/text items)
FFTSceneManager and SignalSceneManager share the teardown contract including subclass resources (peak/peak_item, signal)

notes: Repo src/urh/SceneManager.py inits plot_data to np.array([0]*100) with a ZoomableScene holding a line item and a text item (2 items, matching the test's >=2 setup assertion); FFTSceneManager adds peak/peak_item and a clear_peak that dereferences peak_item; SignalSceneManager stores signal without touching it at construction (works with a sentinel).
